messages.text:
I don't have anything that reproduces an actual 1948 map — our globes all carry current cartography. What you get is that same antique, old-world look you're picturing: warm sepia seas, aged-paper tones, the kind of piece that looks like it's been on a library shelf for decades. The Globemaster 12" Antique Ocean Desk Globe you're looking at is exactly that style, with a raised relief map and metal semi-meridian for a nice vintage desk piece.

Is this for your own desk, or a gift for someone who loves that old-world look?
